# Code of Conduct

This project has adopted the **Contributor Covenant** (v2.1) as its Code of Conduct.
The full text is published here:

https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/

By taking part in this project (issues, pull requests, Discord, in-game) you agree to
uphold it. To raise a concern, contact the maintainers in the
[DSF Discord](https://discord.gg/nrzMBA6XVc).
